about: SAMPLE prompt set, not the production one. The production prompts are private (they would show what the screen looks for); this file shows the format and gives one plain description per group, so the service runs and its tests pass. Vectors in prompts.npy (same order) are the SigLIP 2 text vectors of exactly these texts. Score of an image for one prompt: sigmoid(cos(image, prompt) * exp(logit_scale) + logit_bias); a group's score is the maximum over its prompts. 'ordinary' prompts are negatives. Rebuild with tools/build-prompts.py.
